question: Which Indian state won its maiden Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy title by defeating Haryana in the 2025 final?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Jharkhand defeated Haryana to win the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy 2025.**
 
• **The final was played in Pune on December 18, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Jharkhand won its maiden Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy title.**
 
• **The team defeated Haryana by 69 runs in the final.**
 
• **Ishan Kishan scored a record 101 in the title clash.**
 
• **This marked Jharkhand’s second major domestic cricket title.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy**__ – India’s premier domestic T20 cricket tournament.
 
• Jharkhand’s first domestic title came in the Vijay Hazare Trophy in 2010–11.
 
• The team suffered only one defeat during the 2025 tournament.
 
• The victory highlighted Jharkhand’s consistency and depth in domestic cricket.
